title: Page 9
content_zh:
过日子是远比你爱我我爱你更沉重更复杂百倍千倍的事，要想幸福，只有彼此相爱还远远不够，还需要许多许多的共同努力，以及信任。

还好，一路走来，她和他始终并肩携手，虽然也有不少挫折，但最初的誓言谁也没有忘记，彼此的手谁也没有放开。

最后她轻松地又笑起来，在他怀里笑个不停，她此时觉得自己快乐极了，能让自己父母气到上火的原琅简直太无敌了，自家那对同样无敌的爹娘终于踢到了铁板。

因为曾经答应玄渊自己不会插手政事，所以原嘉宁目前还不是太了解燕京的局势，她知道自家母亲做出那样的选择，一定也是被逼得无奈到了极点，两害相权取其轻，云青萝选择维护自己女儿的名誉和生命，放弃了自己女婿的节操，也是她的一片为母之心。

可是原嘉宁很想告诉母亲，再给她和原琅一点时间和信任啊，作为原修之和云青萝一手抚养长大的儿女，他们怎么会轻易向世俗规则低头？

是，历史上还从来没有出现过忠贞不二的皇帝和太子，但是这并不意味着玄渊做不到。

历史，从来都是需要人去打破的。

再说她运气好，又不是没有生儿子，如今她儿女双全了，她现在身体依然健康，以后孩子还会更多，连「无子」这七出之条她都不在其中，外人究竟还想用什么名义罗织她的罪名？

第10章(2)

等原嘉宁的笑声停止，情绪稍微平静一些之后，玄渊也收起了嬉笑之色，转而郑重地看着她，说：「我向父皇递了请求回京的折子，或许过不多久，我们就可以去燕京了。」

原嘉宁更加惊讶了，有些不解地看着他。

玄渊解释：「太子远离朝堂，久了或许就真的成了局外人，如果朝廷发生了什么意外，洲门距离千里之外，恐怕也会有心无力。」

比如皇帝万一突然驾崩，远在金陵的太子不能及时得到消息，身在燕京的其他皇子或许就会利用这个机会逼宫政变，抢先登基，这就麻烦了。

玄渊继续解释：「从以前的惯例来看，皇帝其实也不会太放心长久把太子放在远处，离开了他的监视。」

玄昱当初把玄渊留在金陵，是因为迁都之事非常麻烦，拖拖拉拉要很久，再加上到了燕京整体安顿下来，同样需要许久，安顿下来再适应适应，再加上御驾亲征又花费不少的时间，这才使得太子不在皇帝身边，反而在京城之外的旧都留守了好几年。

但是光看这两年针对东宫的阴谋层出不断，就知道那些人已经蠢蠢欲动了，玄渊如果再留在金陵，就真的不是好事了。

「而且，最重要的是，」玄渊握紧原嘉宁的手。「我要带你赴京，我要亲手去斩断那些伸向你和孩子们的黑手，我会向父皇禀明此事，我忍耐够久了，再忍下去，也太窝囊了。」

原嘉宁反握住他的手，轻轻点了点头，说：「你去哪儿，我就跟着你去哪儿。」

几日后，玄昱的圣旨就到达了金陵，宣召太子和太子妃一家人搬迁去燕京。

太子的仪仗虽然比不上皇帝，但也不算是个小事，他们要搬迁，又要安置好金陵城和江南事务的管理，纷纷扰扰也忙碌了半个月才开始起程。

先是水路，后又转乘马车，一路走来晓行夜宿，除了在船上或者车子内有点无聊，太子和太子妃倒没有受多少苦楚，他们毕竟年轻，而且身体都很健康，都还受得住这种舟车劳顿。

原嘉宁想到很快就能见到自家的大儿子长生了，所以心情格外兴奋和愉悦。

距离京城百里路时，他们就遇到了来迎接的皇家仪仗队和礼部官员们，但是真正让玄渊和原嘉宁开心的，是瑜王夫妇居然也来迎接他们了。

两家人热络地彼此见礼。

瑜王妃伸手拉着原嘉宁的手，将她上下打量了一番，见她虽然因为旅途劳累而略显疲惫，精神却很不错，眼神中也没有抑郁之色，便略显安心地说道：「或许你现在也知道了，最近京城里多风雨，不过你不用怕，只要自己心里想得开，流言蜚语杀不了人，而如果他们真敢来硬的，皇婶我披挂上阵保护你！」

原嘉宁有些诧异，微微瞪大了眼睛看着这位出身将门的王妃，心底极为感动，这是她回到京城遇到的第一份助力，让她眼眶都有些微微发热，她说：「皇婶，谢谢你。」

「谢啥？」瑜王妃是个爽快利落的女人，不爱那些虚伪客套，直言说：「我帮你，其实也存了我自己的私心，以前多少人讥讽我是无法生育，讥讽王爷不能人道，我呸！她们不过是嫉妒我和王爷恩爱专一，她们自己得不到，过着生不如死的日子，就去编派别人的不是，其实谁晚上孤枕难眠，自个儿都清楚，女人偏爱为难女人，一群自私又可悲的货色，我早看她们不顺眼了。」

原嘉宁在内心暗冒冷汗，这位王妃真的很泼辣啊。

瑜王妃又说：「以前王爷就和我说过，太子殿下是个不错的人，我当初还不以为然，现在看他身为太子居然肯只守着你一个，好！真的很好！就为这件事，我就要王爷以后多帮着他。」

原嘉宁这次不仅是冷汗，干脆都想叹气了，王妃殿下啊，这种事大家只要意会就好，像你这样明目张胆地宣布出来，不太好吧？

「还有，我们瑜王府也有继承人啦，已经被皇上封为世子，我和王爷百年之后也有人供奉了。」瑜王妃突然喜孜孜地转了话题。

原嘉宁更是惊讶，她从没听说过瑜王妃怀孕生子的消息呀？

见她疑惑不解，瑜王妃满脸笑意地解释：「我啊，是注定不能生了，王爷也不愿意再纳新人，所以皇上就把二皇子玄潜过继给我们，虽然那小子文质彬彬，不太合我的脾气，但还算是个乖巧识大体的好孩子，王爷很疼爱他。这是刚刚才宣布的事儿，所以你不知道很正常。」

原嘉宁若有所思地点了点头。

皇上把玄潜过继给瑜王爷，彻底断了玄潜继承皇位的可能性，但是这对于身体虚弱的玄潜来说，或许反而是好事，从此跳脱出了争权夺位的腥风血雨，以后做个富贵闲王，又何尝不是一种幸福？

二皇子过继了；三皇子只封了郡王不派差事，慢慢也能养成个闲王，就算他想伸手夺权，都拉不到多少人马；四皇子还小，又被转交给耿贵妃抚养，耿贵妃不是他的生母，不会一心一意为他盘算，再加上耿贵妃又一心想求个安稳晚年，替自己所生的公主找个好婆家，所以大概也不会怂恿四皇子长大了争权夺位。

看来，皇帝玄昱已经做了最大的努力，为太子玄渊继位铺好了道路，在玄昱驾崩以前，只要玄渊做个乖巧听话的太子，大概就能顺理成章地做下一任皇帝了。

这样一想，原嘉宁忽然就有点感慨，不管是为了国家的平稳政权过渡也好，为了自己的儿女日后少点自相残杀也好，玄昱从某种程度上讲，也算是费尽心机，算是一个好皇帝、好父亲了。

或许，在这样一位强势皇帝的统治之下，做一位只要乖乖听话就能快乐无忧的太子妃，其实也算是原嘉宁的幸运了。

太子的仪仗从南门进京，到达正阳门时，有小太监到原嘉宁面前传话，太子请太子妃到他的马车上去。
content_en:
Living a life is a matter that is a hundred times more complicated than you loving me and me loving you. If you want to be happy, loving each other is not enough. It also requires many, many joint efforts and trust.

Fortunately, she and he have always been hand in hand along the way. Although there have been many setbacks, no one has forgotten the original vow and no one has let go of each other's hands.

Finally, she laughed easily again and kept laughing in his arms. She felt extremely happy at this moment. Yuan Lang, who could make her parents so angry, was so invincible. Her parents, who were also invincible, finally hit the iron wall.

Because she had promised Xuan Yuan that she would not interfere in political affairs, Yuan Jianing did not know much about the situation in Yanjing at present. She knew that her mother must have been forced to the extreme to make such a choice. She chose the lesser of two evils. Yun Qingluo chose to protect her daughter's reputation and life and gave up her son-in-law's integrity, which was also her mother's heart.

But Yuan Jianing wanted to tell her mother and give her and Yuan Lang a little more time and trust. As the children raised by Yuan Xiuzhi and Yun Qingluo, how could they easily bow to secular rules?

Yes, there has never been a loyal emperor or prince in history, but this does not mean that Xuan Yuan cannot do it.

History always needs people to break it.

Besides, she is lucky. It's not like she didn't give birth to a son. Now she has both children. She is still in good health and will have more children in the future. She is not even included in the "childless" rule. What other name do outsiders want to use to accuse her?

Chapter 10(2)

After Yuan Jianing's laughter stopped and her mood calmed down a little, Xuan Yuan also stopped laughing and looked at her solemnly, saying, "I handed my father a request to return to Beijing. Maybe we can go to Yanjing in a short time."

Yuan Jianing was even more surprised and looked at him with some confusion.

Xuan Yuan explained: "The prince stays away from the court for a long time, and he may really become an outsider. If something unexpected happens to the court, and the gate is thousands of miles away, I am afraid he will be helpless."

For example, if the emperor dies suddenly and the prince in Jinling cannot get the news in time, other princes in Yanjing may use this opportunity to force a coup in the palace and ascend the throne first, which will be troublesome.

Xuan Yuan continued to explain: "Judging from previous practice, the emperor would not be too relieved to leave the prince far away for a long time, away from his supervision."

Xuan Yu originally left Xuanyuan in Jinling because it was very troublesome to move the capital and it took a long time. In addition, it also took a long time to settle down in Yanjing. It also took a long time to settle down and adapt. In addition, it took a lot of time for the imperial commander to go to Jinling. This made the prince no longer with the emperor, but stayed in the old capital outside the capital for several years.

But just by looking at the constant conspiracies against the East Palace in the past two years, we know that those people are already ready to make a move. It would really not be a good thing if Xuan Yuan stayed in Jinling any longer.

"And, most importantly," Xuan Yuan squeezed Yuan Jianing's hand."I'm going to take you to the capital. I'm going to personally cut off the evil hands that are reaching out to you and the children. I'm going to tell my father about this. I've endured it long enough. If I can endure it any longer, it's too cowardly."

Yuan Jianing held his hand, nodded slightly, and said, "Wherever you go, I will follow you."

A few days later, Xuan Yu's imperial edict arrived in Jinling, calling the prince and his family to move to Yanjing.

Although the prince's ceremonial guard was not as good as that of the emperor, it was not a small matter. They had to move and arrange the management of Jinling City and Jiangnan affairs. They were busy for half a month before starting their journey.

First by water, then by carriage, they stayed overnight at Xiaoxing. Apart from being a little bored on the boat or in the carriage, the prince and the princess did not suffer much. After all, they were young and in good health, so they could still withstand the fatigue of traveling and traveling.

Yuan Jianing thought that she would soon see her eldest son live forever, so she felt particularly excited and happy.

When they were a hundred miles away from the capital, they met the royal honor guard and officials from the Ministry of Etiquette who came to greet them. But what really made Xuan Yuan and Yuan Jianing happy was that Prince Yu and his wife also came to greet them.

The two families greeted each other warmly.

Princess Yu reached out to hold Yuan Jianing's hand and looked her up and down. Seeing that although she was a little tired due to the journey, she was in good spirits and there was no depression in her eyes. She said with a little peace of mind: "Perhaps you know now that there has been a lot of wind and rain in the capital recently, but you don't have to be afraid. As long as you think openly, rumors can't kill people. And if they really dare to come hard, I will go into battle to protect you!"

Yuan Jianing was a little surprised. She widened her eyes slightly and looked at the princess who was born in a general family. She was extremely moved in her heart. This was the first help she received when she returned to the capital. It made her eyes slightly warm. She said, "Auntie, thank you."

"Thank you for what?" Princess Yu is a straightforward woman who doesn't like those hypocritical politeness. She said bluntly: "I help you, but I also have my own selfish motives. How many people used to ridicule me for being infertile and ridicule the prince for being inhumane. Bah! They are just jealous of me andThe prince's love is devoted, but they can't get it themselves. They live a life that is worse than death, so they go to arrange other people's faults. In fact, anyone who can't sleep alone at night knows that women prefer to embarrass women. They are a group of selfish and pathetic people. I have long disliked them."

Yuan Jianing was sweating secretly in her heart. This princess was really fierce.

Princess Yu added, "Your Highness has told me before that His Highness the Crown Prince is a good person. I didn't think so at first. But now I see that as the Crown Prince, he is willing to stay with you alone. Good! It's really good! Just for this reason, I want Your Highness to help him more in the future."

Yuan Jianing not only broke out in a cold sweat this time, but also wanted to sigh. Her Royal Highness, everyone just needs to be aware of this kind of thing. Isn't it bad to announce it so blatantly like you?

"Also, our Prince Yu's Palace also has an heir. He has been named the crown prince by the emperor. A hundred years later, the prince and I will also have someone to worship him." Princess Yu suddenly changed the topic happily.

Yuan Jianing was even more surprised. She had never heard about Princess Yu being pregnant and giving birth?

Seeing her confusion, Princess Yu explained with a smile on her face: "I am destined not to have children, and the prince is not willing to accept new people, so the emperor adopted the second prince Xuan Qian to us. Although the boy is gentle and gentle, which does not suit my temper, he is still a good boy who is well-behaved and knowledgeable. The prince loves him very much. This was just announced, so it is normal for you not to know."

Yuan Jianing nodded thoughtfully.

The emperor adopted Xuan Qian to Prince Yu, which completely eliminated the possibility of Xuan Qian inheriting the throne. However, this may be a good thing for the weak Xuan Qian. He has escaped from the bloody struggle for power and is now a rich and idle king. Isn't it a blessing?

The second prince was adopted; the third prince was only given the title of county prince without sending any errands, and he gradually became a free king. Even if he wanted to seize power, he could not attract many people; the fourth prince was still young and was given to Concubine Geng to raise.She is not his biological mother, so she will not plan for him wholeheartedly. In addition, Concubine Geng wants to have a stable old age and find a good husband for the princess she gave birth to, so she probably will not encourage the fourth prince to fight for power when he grows up.

It seems that Emperor Xuan Yu has done his best to pave the way for Prince Xuan Yuan to succeed to the throne. Before Xuan Yu's death, as long as Xuan Yuan is a well-behaved and obedient prince, he will probably be able to become the next emperor.

Thinking of this, Yuan Jianing suddenly felt a little emotional. Whether it was for the smooth transition of power in the country or for his children to be less likely to kill each other in the future, to a certain extent, Xuan Yu could be considered a good emperor and a good father because he worked hard.

Perhaps, under the rule of such a strong emperor, Yuan Jianing was lucky to be a happy and carefree princess as long as she was obedient.

The prince's guard of honor entered the capital from the South Gate. When they arrived at Zhengyang Gate, a young eunuch came to Yuan Jianing to deliver a message. The prince asked the princess to get on his carriage.
